jobs.prompt:
Train 5: make the S10 Command Center the default dashboard while keeping the old board reachable, and cover it with tests.

1) tools/command-center-flag.mjs: commandCenterEnabled is currently opt-in. New semantics: enabled by default; disabled when SWARM_COMMAND_CENTER is the string '0' or config.commandCenter === false; still enabled for '1' or config.commandCenter === true. Keep the function signature and comments.

2) tools/watch-server.mjs: when the Command Center is enabled, serve the Command Center Hive page at `/` (the dashboard root) and serve the classic board index (the existing indexName/board.html) at `/classic`. When it is disabled, `/` serves the classic board as today and `/classic` also serves the classic board (so the link never 404s). Add `/classic` to the route allowlist and to the HTML-page token/cookie handling (it is a page, so the query token works). Keep `/command-center` and `/command-center/project/...` as they are; keep the classic `/project` and `/run` routes unchanged. Do not break the remote-host rules (a remote board is read-only; `/classic` is a page).

3) tools/watch-assets/cc-hive-mount.js: the existing Classic tab currently links to `/` with the search string. Point it at `/classic` with the same search string (so the old board stays reachable from the new dashboard). Keep the other tabs/routes.

4) Tests: update tests/command-center-flag.test.mjs for the new default (enabled with no env/config, disabled for '0' and config false, enabled for '1' and config true). Update tests/command-center-routes-flag.test.mjs (and any watch-server route test that asserts `/` is the classic index) so: enabled -> `/` returns the Command Center page and `/classic` returns the classic board index; disabled -> both return the classic board; `/command-center` still works when enabled; the token-gated page handling works for `/classic`. Add a test asserting the Hive Classic tab href points at /classic. Keep every other assertion.

Verify: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/command-center-flag.test.mjs tests/command-center-routes-flag.test.mjs tests/command-center-nav.test.mjs tests/cc-hive-mount.test.mjs tests/command-center-boot.test.mjs -> all pass. Report counts and the exact behavior table (enabled/disabled x / and /classic).
